name: Do I need to paint or finish new door casing after installation?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to paint or finish new door casing after installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, most new door casing materials, especially wood or MDF, will need to be painted or stained after installation to match your home's interior. This step protects the material and ensures a finished look. If you choose pre-primed casing, it will still require a topcoat of paint. We recommend applying a high-quality primer before painting to achieve the best adhesion and a smooth finish. Maine Results, Inc. focuses on the installation, but we can advise on the best finishing practices for the chosen material.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most new door casing requires painting or staining after installation to match your interior and protect the material; pre-primed still needs a topcoat.
